Answer: B
Reason: The CT images (specifically Figure 2a and 2b) demonstrate a focal nodular/consolidative lesion in the left upper lobe (suggesting a reactivation focus or Ghon focus) alongside micronodular opacities that are more prominent in the right lung fields, fitting the description of predominant lesions in the right upper/middle lobes with a left upper lobe focus. This asymmetric distribution with a specific upper lobe focus is characteristic of reactivation tuberculosis with hematogenous spread (miliary pattern), distinguishing it from the perfectly uniform distribution of classic primary miliary TB.
